entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
Kia ora! Meet Theodore. Kids can’t imagine the real difference money can make. But you can. Working for Families payments support families busy raising the next generation. Check our calculator to see what payments your family might qualify for. You’ll just need your family details and income information handy.  

Find out more: https://www.ird.govt.nz/working-for-families/
